notes.title: Get the Steam-Exclusive Unicorn Mount
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161033/740b2c01c1f30d678d7e43e3d348dfe513f66ef6.gif[/img]

Dear adventurers, 

To welcome new Steam players to Tarisland, we prepared the Steam-exclusive mount [b]Steam Unicorn[/b] and the exclusive avatar[b] Steam Mark[/b] for you!

[h3]How to Earn the mount Steam Unicorn[/h3]
The Tarisland team will distribute rewards in two phases.
[list]
[*]Phase One: New players who register between October 22 and October 28 will receive their in-game rewards on October 30, 2024.
[*]Phase Two: New players who register between October 29 and November 5 will receive their in-game rewards on November 7, 2024.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161033/04bcf73fec75f492502e15ac2ed91a5eac09f3ea.png[/img]
[i]Note: Awards are only available for new players who create a character on the server for the first time through the Steam platform.[/i]

We can't wait to see you in Tarisland on Steam!

notes.title: Tarisland S1: Welcome to Scardino Icefield!
notes.content:
Dear adventurers,

This October, prepare for [b]Tarisland S1: Blight Dragon Elegy[/b]! Following the epic battles of S0, our journey now takes us to the Scardino Icefield, the realm of the Snow Lion Clan and ancient legends. Brave the icy winds and uncover the secrets of this mysterious land in our thrilling upcoming season!❄️

[h3]New Map: Scardino Icefield[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161033/5d02d190b452ab90b8894e6a2194d6cdbc5aacf5.jpg[/img]
[i]*Map of the Scardino Icefield[/i]

The Scardino Icefield is located at the North Pole of Tarisland, characterized by its extremely harsh environment. The first group of people to venture into this land were later known as the "Northerners." They discovered dragon bones beneath the ice and cast them into the fire during the Flame Ritual Festival, praying for divine blessings. Since then, the flame has never extinguished.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161033/97515cdd09b123a88f25025e7d421e148634418b.jpg[/img]
[i]*Site of the Flame Ritual Festival[/i]


Thanks to Skyfire, the Northerners were blessed by the gods. Skyfire brought alchemy to humanity, helping them establish the Auden Dynasty and build the magnificent Fort Grenny on the Scardino Icefield. However, gems can invite jealousy. Skyfire and alchemy attracted endless pirates, prompting the Auden royal family to deploy heavy troops to guard the site where the dragon bones were found, naming it the "Dragonbone Ruins."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161033/c000b5e9b3ba764fed7dd6d1cf3d5c5574422716.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161033/5b11ed3dbe7a5fd7b4ab424be794dfb1a043641c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161033/b425152a041a8037b4312214fb5705d0689570db.jpg[/img]
[i]*Dragonbone Ruins[/i]

As time passed, the legend of the Auden royal family and dragons lost its glory, and what was once their homeland is now becoming a lair for demons. In the Blight Dragon Elegy season, adventurers will embark on a new journey across this Icefield, encountering the reclusive Snow Lion Clan and the Frost Dragon hidden deep within, witnessing an epic tale of revenge plotted by the once-noble royals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161033/c208b5fc51823a4e8ae0067cf0a72eeffe86c725.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161033/4245a2b01768212a4dc899ee2428bf4a17f46ef7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161033/51bc9ad9f21fe225902b0c8e4baac62bae76e30e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161033/c6b60c9df71f3bcd9740363e9ef0f5c2190b98d8.png[/img]
[i]*Kingdom of Grenny[/i]

Prepare to embark on this new adventure with your friends, uncover the secrets of the Scardino Icefield, challenge powerful enemies, and write your own legendary story! We look forward to seeing you in Tarisland!
